description: Four sheet generations create 44 components. Hair and outfits contain 12 options each; face sheet has 6 shapes for each body; expressions has 4 eye and 4 mouth styles. Crops and target positions in catalog.json register the sheets to the existing portrait.

sheets.prompt: Production pixel-art AVATAR SPRITE SHEET, not individual illustrations. EXACT regular grid, equal square cells edge-to-edge, zero gutters and no labels, no grid lines, no text. Use the supplied existing RepoCompany avatar as the strict style, palette, pose, scale and alignment reference. Every cell is the SAME full portrait canvas (approximately 80x80 intentional pixel clusters, enlarged neatly), not a tightly cropped item. Three-quarter view looking toward image LEFT. Simple chunky burgundy outlines, restrained peach/rose skin shading and chestnut/amber hair; no realistic rendering, no fine strands, no new art style. Every cell uses IDENTICAL registration: relative to a 512x512 cell, skull top at (256,74), left temple (129,189), eyes centered (153,224) and (243,224), nose tip (187,283), mouth centered (199,313), visible right ear spans x320..381 and y191..286, collar opening ends near (250,448), torso extends to bottom edge. Preserve the reference upper-face registration exactly, no recentering or zoom. Create a 4-column by 3-row sheet, 2048x1536 if possible, containing TWELVE full BALD CLEAN-SHAVEN base portraits on the original warm ochre background. Image1 male and Image2 female are the bases. Retain exact existing eyes, nose, neutral mouth, scalp, ear, neck, slate jacket and teal shirt. Change only cheeks, lower jaw and chin silhouette and its shading. All variants have natural balanced anatomy and a shorter, softer chin than the excessively long pointed source male chin. No beard or hair. Order left to right, top to bottom: 1 masculine balanced natural oval jaw, 2 masculine soft rounded jaw, 3 masculine strong square jaw with subtle cleft, 4 masculine round fuller cheeks, 5 masculine gently tapered jaw (not pointed), 6 masculine broad mature jaw; 7 feminine balanced natural oval jaw, 8 feminine soft rounded jaw, 9 feminine defined square jaw, 10 feminine round fuller cheeks, 11 feminine gently tapered jaw, 12 feminine broad mature jaw. Keep chin at roughly y357..374 within each cell, with enough natural neck. All twelve portraits must be SAME size and position. Shirt and jacket and backgrounds repeated identically in every tile. Do not add highlights outside face. Each jaw is clearly distinct yet belongs to the same character system.
